info.name: MapMyTour Auth Service (Full)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for MapMyTour auth-service: Auth, OAuth2, User endpoints.

✅ COMPLETE COLLECTION - All 175+ REST endpoints + 5 WebSocket endpoints included!

📋 ENDPOINT BREAKDOWN:
- AuthController: 49 endpoints (Public, Protected, Admin, Agent Registration)
- UserController: 104 endpoints (Profile, Messaging, Travel, Expenses, etc.)
- OAuth2Controller: 5 endpoints (Google, Facebook login/link/unlink)
- OAuth2DiagnosticController: 1 endpoint (Configuration diagnostic)
- TripCircleController: 15 endpoints (Circles, Posts, Polls, Bookings)
- BookingAttributionController: 1 endpoint (Internal booking attribution)
- WebSocketMessageController: 5 STOMP endpoints (Group/Direct messaging, Typing, Heartbeat)

🔐 AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY:
- Register (User & Agent with documents), Login (email/password & OTP), 2FA, Password Reset
- Token Management: Refresh, Validate, Revoke
- Session & Device Management
- Security Logs & Rate Limiting

🔗 OAUTH2:
- Google & Facebook login
- Account linking/unlinking
- OAuth2 status check
- Diagnostic configuration

👤 USER MANAGEMENT:
- Profile: Get, Update, Visibility, Avatar, Cover Image
- Addresses: Save, Update, Delete, List
- Preferences: Notifications, Privacy, Interests
- Documents: Upload, Get, Delete
- Activity Tracking: Package views, clicks, page views
- Connections: Send/accept/reject/withdraw requests, view connections

✈️ TRAVEL FEATURES:
- Travel Plans: Create, Update, Delete, Find by destination
- Travel Groups: Create, Join, Leave, Invite, Discover, Upload Image
- Group Messaging: Send/receive messages in travel groups
- Direct Messaging: 1-on-1 conversations
- Expense Splitting: Create expenses, track payments, settlement
- Travel Itinerary: Create, Update, Delete, Get by date/group
- Travel Matches: Find compatible travelers
- Nearby Travelers: Find by destination and location

🛠️ ADMIN FEATURES:
- User Management: List, Update, Activate/Deactivate
- Activity Monitoring: View all user activities
- Login History: View with filtering
- Role Management: Create roles, assign to users
- Verification Requests: Get, Approve, Reject

📝 Set collection variables: baseUrl, accessToken, refreshToken, userId, sessionId, deviceId, documentId, requestId, connectionId, planId, groupId, itemId, messageId, expenseId, circleId, destinationId, postId, pollId, optionId.

💡 Note: Use baseUrl=http://localhost:8080 for API Gateway or http://localhost:8081 for direct auth-service access.

item.name: WebSockets
item.description: Documentation for WebSocket/STOMP destinations exposed by WebSocketMessageController.

request.description:
WebSocket STOMP endpoint.

Connect WebSocket to ws://<host>/ws (or the configured STOMP endpoint).

Client SEND: /app/direct/message
Server SEND to recipient: /user/queue/messages

Payload example:
{
  "recipientEmail": "user@example.com",
  "message": "Hi!",
  "messageType": "TEXT"
}

WebSocket STOMP endpoint.

Connect WebSocket to ws://<host>/ws (or the configured STOMP endpoint).

Client SEND: /app/group/{groupId}/typing
Server BROADCAST: /topic/group/{groupId}/typing

Payload example:
{
  "isTyping": true
}

The backend fills in the userEmail from the authenticated Principal.

WebSocket STOMP endpoint.

Connect WebSocket to ws://<host>/ws (or the configured STOMP endpoint).

Client SEND: /app/direct/typing
Server SEND to recipient: /user/queue/typing

Payload example:
{
  "recipientEmail": "user@example.com",
  "isTyping": true
}

WebSocket STOMP endpoint to keep connection alive and update presence.

Connect WebSocket to ws://<host>/ws (or the configured STOMP endpoint).

Client SEND: /app/heartbeat
Server responds to: /user/queue/heartbeat

No payload required. Returns 'OK' on success.
